definition: Extreme moral corruption shown through cruel or wicked behaviour.
author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
quote: All that infamy had obviously only touched her mechanically, not one drop of real depravity had penetrated to her heart; he saw that.
example_sentence: The detective was shocked by the depravity of the crime.
